concerns.text: FR-004 adds a hard runtime and RAM limit (≤ 7 GB RAM, ≤ 6 h total) which was never mentioned in the original idea. This imposes an engineering constraint beyond the scientific scope.

FR-007 requires a multiple‑comparison correction (Bonferroni or FDR). The idea’s methodology only calls for bootstrap variance comparison; no hypothesis‑testing correction was requested, so this is an unnecessary scope expansion.
FR-012 introduces a low‑sunspot offset term calibrated from satellite data. The original idea did not specify such a term; it adds a modelling component not required to answer the research question.
SC-005 defines a sensitivity analysis on an “inconsistency tolerance threshold” (0.01, 0.05, 0.1). The idea never asked for this analysis, making it an out‑of‑scope metric.

FR-010 mandates ingestion of the CMIP6 v3.2 solar forcing dataset for independent validation, but the idea only cited CMIP6 as related work, not as a validation target. Using it as a primary validation source extends the scope.
FR-011 requires reporting RMSE and bias against CMIP6, which follows from FR-010 and thus inherits the same over‑reach.
The edge‑case handling for instrument drift and gap‑flagging adds processing steps (calibration corrections, sensitivity analysis) that were not part of the original research question.
